  "title": "Resident Engineer",
  "description": "At Viabonam Corporate Services - We help our clients Simplify, re-energize, and Grow their businesses in Nigeria. Expanding the geographic footprints of our client&rsquo;s business into Nigeria will always pose a risky and expensive proposition &ndash; the risks have not gone away, they&rsquo;ve just shifted. That&rsquo;s where we come in&hellip; We provide tailor-made solutions that drive businesses to success including everything required for a &lsquo;genuine presence&rsquo; in Nigeria from company formation, tax-efficient corporate structuring, and full local business support from our offices in Nigeria.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Resident Engineer&nbsp;

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary&nbsp;


	The Resident Engineer is responsible for providing on-site technical support, troubleshooting, and maintenance of network infrastructure at a designated client location.
	This role ensures network stability, high availability, and optimal performance of the ISP&rsquo;s services, working closely with both internal teams and the client&rsquo;s IT department.


Responsibilities
Network Monitoring &amp; Maintenance:


	Continuously monitor network performance, uptime, and service quality at the client&rsquo;s site.
	Identify, diagnose, and resolve network faults, latency issues, and service disruptions.
	Perform routine maintenance, software upgrades, and patch management on networking equipment.


Technical Support &amp; Troubleshooting:


	Provide first-line and second-line support for all network-related issues at the client&rsquo;s location.
	Handle fiber, microwave, and wired network troubleshooting, including CPE configurations.
	Work with the NOC (Network Operations Center) to resolve escalated issues and ensure minimal downtime.


Installation &amp; Configuration:


	Deploy and configure routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices.
	Conduct fiber splicing, termination, and testing where required.
	Ensure proper installation and documentation of all network components.


Client Relationship Management:


	Act as the primary technical contact for the client, ensuring prompt issue resolution and satisfaction.
	Maintain clear communication and regular status updates with the client&rsquo;s IT team.
	Provide guidance on network optimization and best practices.


Documentation &amp; Reporting:


	Maintain accurate incident logs, service reports, and network diagrams.
	Generate weekly/monthly reports on network performance, issues, and resolutions.
	Document all troubleshooting steps and solutions for future reference.
	Prepare and submit network monitoring and uptime report


Skills and competencies


	Strong knowledge of ISP technologies, including FTTH, FTTX, MPLS, VLANs, and BGP.
	Hands-on experience with routing, switching, firewall configurations, and wireless networks.
	Proficiency in network troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, PRTG, MRTG, SolarWinds, etc.).
	Knowledge of fiber optics, RF/microwave links, and structured cabling.
	Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
	Strong customer service and communication skills.
	Ability to work independently and under pressure in high-demand environments.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: ma@viabonam.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Resident Engineer Job at Viabonam Corporate Services




        
    

        
        At Viabonam Corporate Services - We help our clients Simplify, re-energize, and Grow their businesses in Nigeria. Expanding the geographic footprints of our client’s business into Nigeria will always pose a risky and expensive proposition – the risks have not gone away, they’ve just shifted. That’s where we come in… We provide tailor-made solutions that drive businesses to success including everything required for a ‘genuine presence’ in Nigeria from company formation, tax-efficient corporate structuring, and full local business support from our offices in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Resident Engineer 
     

            
    



Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary 


	The Resident Engineer is responsible for providing on-site technical support, troubleshooting, and maintenance of network infrastructure at a designated client location.
	This role ensures network stability, high availability, and optimal performance of the ISP’s services, working closely with both internal teams and the client’s IT department.


Responsibilities
Network Monitoring & Maintenance:


	Continuously monitor network performance, uptime, and service quality at the client’s site.
	Identify, diagnose, and resolve network faults, latency issues, and service disruptions.
	Perform routine maintenance, software upgrades, and patch management on networking equipment.


Technical Support & Troubleshooting:


	Provide first-line and second-line support for all network-related issues at the client’s location.
	Handle fiber, microwave, and wired network troubleshooting, including CPE configurations.
	Work with the NOC (Network Operations Center) to resolve escalated issues and ensure minimal downtime.


Installation & Configuration:


	Deploy and configure routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices.
	Conduct fiber splicing, termination, and testing where required.
	Ensure proper installation and documentation of all network components.


Client Relationship Management:


	Act as the primary technical contact for the client, ensuring prompt issue resolution and satisfaction.
	Maintain clear communication and regular status updates with the client’s IT team.
	Provide guidance on network optimization and best practices.


Documentation & Reporting:


	Maintain accurate incident logs, service reports, and network diagrams.
	Generate weekly/monthly reports on network performance, issues, and resolutions.
	Document all troubleshooting steps and solutions for future reference.
	Prepare and submit network monitoring and uptime report


Skills and competencies


	Strong knowledge of ISP technologies, including FTTH, FTTX, MPLS, VLANs, and BGP.
	Hands-on experience with routing, switching, firewall configurations, and wireless networks.
	Proficiency in network troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, PRTG, MRTG, SolarWinds, etc.).
	Knowledge of fiber optics, RF/microwave links, and structured cabling.
	Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
	Strong customer service and communication skills.
	Ability to work independently and under pressure in high-demand environments.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Health Facilitator Job at Dorisfit




        
    

        
        Dorisfit is into wellness and healthy living. We render home service for various kinds of body massage therapy and personal training to keep fit and nice body shape. We also put you on a healthy diet a through our research nutrition you will live healthy and stay longer. Also, skin problems and issues we have good skincare products to help solve that.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Health Facilitator 

Job Location: Aliosho, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilties
     

            
    




	Assist healthcare providers in organizing patient flow, registration, and ensuring smooth daily operations within the facility.
	Provide health awareness sessions to patients and caregivers on key topics such as hygiene, nutrition, disease prevention, and maternal and child health.
	Collaborate with the health team to identify community health needs and support the development of appropriate response activities.
	Monitor patients need and provide guidance or referrals to appropriate services within the PHCC or external partners when necessary.
	Ensure a safe, respectful, and inclusive environment for all patients, with special attention to children and vulnerable groups.
	Adhere to and promote child safeguarding, protection standards, and confidentiality of patient information always.
	Identify challenges in service delivery and work with the health team to address them effectively.
	Support coordination with community stakeholders to enhance access to health services and community outreach efforts.
	Assist in maintaining accurate records and databases while ensuring data protection and confidentiality.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an HND / Bachelor's Degree with 1 - 7 years of experience. 


Salary
N300,000 - N500,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "title": "Structural Design Engineer",
  "description": "Trucrete Solutions Limited is dynamic Construction Management firm with expertise in Infrastructural Development, Engineering Services, Procurement, Facility Management, and General Contracting. With several groundbreaking engineering projects in our portfolio over the years, Trucrete is proud to have been involved in shaping Nigeria by elevating critical infrastructure to international standards, erecting buildings, bridges, flyovers and roads in key strategic locations in Nigeria. We have helped create a safer and more pleasant environment, all while encouraging state growth and development.

Our fleet of plant machinery and equipment gives us the capacity to successfully undertake multiple projects in various parts of Nigeria at any one time, while our network of tried and tested subcontractors and suppliers throughout the country and globally, enables us to procure the best resources for every project.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Structural Design Engineer&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos

Description


	We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Structural Design Engineer to join our Design Team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for the structural analysis, design, modelling, and technical review of building and infrastructure projects.
	The role will focus on developing safe, efficient, economical, and code-compliant structural solutions from concept through detailed design.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform structural analysis and design of reinforced concrete, steel, masonry, and composite structures.
	Design foundations, retaining structures, slabs, beams, columns, structural frames, and other load-bearing systems.
	Prepare structural calculations, design reports, technical specifications, schedules, and engineering documentation.
	Develop and maintain structural models using industry-standard software.
	Review structural drawings, calculations, specifications, and design deliverables for accuracy and completeness.
	Conduct design checks and peer reviews where required.
	Identify and resolve design conflicts and technical inconsistencies.
	Coordinate structural designs with architectural, civil, MEP, and other project requirements.
	Collaborate with Architects, Civil Engineers, MEP Engineers, Quantity Surveyors, Project Managers, and other stakeholders.
	Provide technical support and clarification during project development.
	Respond to structural design-related Requests for Information (RFIs).
	Propose innovative and cost-effective structural solutions without compromising safety or performance.
	Support value engineering and design optimization initiatives.
	Provide technical support to project execution teams regarding structural design intent.
	Review site queries, structural shop drawings, and as-built submissions.
	Conduct periodic site visits for structural inspections and design verification when required.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
	Minimum of 8&ndash;10 years of experience in structural design and analysis.
	Master&#39;s Degree in Structural Engineering is an advantage.
	Proven experience designing building and infrastructure projects.
	Proficiency in ETABS, SAFE, SAP2000, STAAD.Pro, AutoCAD, and Revit Structure.
	Knowledge of Eurocodes, British Standards, ACI, AISC, and other relevant codes.
	COREN registration is required or highly desirable.
	NSE membership or other relevant professional certification is an advantage.


Core Competencies:


	Structural Analysis and Design
	Reinforced Concrete and Steel Design
	Structural Modelling and BIM
	Design Review and Quality Assurance
	Technical Documentation
	Value Engineering
	Problem-Solving and Attention to Detail
	Communication and Teamwork.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: trucretecareers@trucreteng.com using &ldquo;Application &ndash; Structural Design Engineer&rdquo; as the subject of the mail.

Structural Design Engineer Job at Trucrete Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        Trucrete Solutions Limited is dynamic Construction Management firm with expertise in Infrastructural Development, Engineering Services, Procurement, Facility Management, and General Contracting. With several groundbreaking engineering projects in our portfolio over the years, Trucrete is proud to have been involved in shaping Nigeria by elevating critical infrastructure to international standards, erecting buildings, bridges, flyovers and roads in key strategic locations in Nigeria. We have helped create a safer and more pleasant environment, all while encouraging state growth and development.
     

            
    



Our fleet of plant machinery and equipment gives us the capacity to successfully undertake multiple projects in various parts of Nigeria at any one time, while our network of tried and tested subcontractors and suppliers throughout the country and globally, enables us to procure the best resources for every project.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Structural Design Engineer 

Job Location: Lagos

Description


	We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Structural Design Engineer to join our Design Team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for the structural analysis, design, modelling, and technical review of building and infrastructure projects.
	The role will focus on developing safe, efficient, economical, and code-compliant structural solutions from concept through detailed design.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform structural analysis and design of reinforced concrete, steel, masonry, and composite structures.
	Design foundations, retaining structures, slabs, beams, columns, structural frames, and other load-bearing systems.
	Prepare structural calculations, design reports, technical specifications, schedules, and engineering documentation.
	Develop and maintain structural models using industry-standard software.
	Review structural drawings, calculations, specifications, and design deliverables for accuracy and completeness.
	Conduct design checks and peer reviews where required.
	Identify and resolve design conflicts and technical inconsistencies.
	Coordinate structural designs with architectural, civil, MEP, and other project requirements.
	Collaborate with Architects, Civil Engineers, MEP Engineers, Quantity Surveyors, Project Managers, and other stakeholders.
	Provide technical support and clarification during project development.
	Respond to structural design-related Requests for Information (RFIs).
	Propose innovative and cost-effective structural solutions without compromising safety or performance.
	Support value engineering and design optimization initiatives.
	Provide technical support to project execution teams regarding structural design intent.
	Review site queries, structural shop drawings, and as-built submissions.
	Conduct periodic site visits for structural inspections and design verification when required.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
	Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in structural design and analysis.
	Master's Degree in Structural Engineering is an advantage.
	Proven experience designing building and infrastructure projects.
	Proficiency in ETABS, SAFE, SAP2000, STAAD.Pro, AutoCAD, and Revit Structure.
	Knowledge of Eurocodes, British Standards, ACI, AISC, and other relevant codes.
	COREN registration is required or highly desirable.
	NSE membership or other relevant professional certification is an advantage.


Core Competencies:


	Structural Analysis and Design
	Reinforced Concrete and Steel Design
	Structural Modelling and BIM
	Design Review and Quality Assurance
	Technical Documentation
	Value Engineering
	Problem-Solving and Attention to Detail
	Communication and Teamwork.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using “Application – Structural Design Engineer” as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
